label: PHASE_S_EXTERNAL_DATA_ESCALATION

primary_recommendation.label: SCENE_PRIOR_SPATIAL_FILTER_WITH_COCO
rationale: COCO yolov8n achieves 100% recall on Paris canary at conf=0.10 (all persons detected)
Failure is misidentification (spectator vs diver), not localization

Pool corridor spatial prior can be estimated from static background: diver moves in pool deck / springboard zone (cy ~0.10-0.50 from top), spectators cluster at edges (cy>0.80 or cy<0.05, or cx at extreme ends)
During flight phase, the diver is the ONLY moving person in the pool deck zone
This approach avoids new training data requirement and preserves the Paris firewall

implementation.step_1: Run COCO at conf=0.10 on full canary video
implementation.step_2: Extract dominant stationary cluster (background subtraction or median cy/cx)
implementation.step_3: Filter: keep detections whose centroid is > K sigma from the stationary cluster centroid
implementation.step_5: Extract trajectory of the track with highest vertical movement (flight arc)
implementation.step_6: Apply Event Logic V2.1 to trajectory

risks: Multiple moving persons in pool deck during warmup phases
Spectator occlusion of diver at takeoff/water_contact
Filter parameters (K sigma) may need tuning — must not use Paris canary GT to tune
primary_recommendation.firewall_note: Pool corridor calibration must be derived from INTERNAL_EVAL or DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN data, NOT from Paris canary frames or GT.

secondary_recommendation.label: MULTI_DOMAIN_TRAINING_DATA
sources: Diving club training videos from different venues
secondary_recommendation.target: 200-500 frames from >= 3 external venues annotated with bounding boxes
secondary_recommendation.expected_improvement: mAP50 >= 0.40 on Paris-style external venue if training corpus is sufficiently diverse

rejected_options.MORE_DATA_SAME_DOMAIN: Insufficient — root cause is venue generalization, not quantity
rejected_options.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE: Deferred — higher effort, uncertain payoff without more data

recommended_immediate_action: Implement SCENE_PRIOR_SPATIAL_FILTER_WITH_COCO and evaluate on Paris canary before committing to multi-domain data collection.
